evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: This call will just take around ten to fifteen minutes. Is now a good time? [Waits for yes, then asks 'what are your biggest concerns'] — time-boxed but does NOT explicitly frame a dependable quote; skips straight to concerns without the full three-part framing.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Before I get the details of your move. I'd like to ask first what are your biggest concerns and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Angel raises 'expensive items... not damaged.' Nicole responds: 'Mm-hmm I see. Mm-hmm. Okay. Mm-hmm.' Then immediately pivots to damage coverage solution without asking 'tell me more' or any follow-up probe. Acknowledged, not explored.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No reflection summary. Nicole jumps to 'The or we do have a no worries damage coverage' without restating what she heard.

evidence_quotes.packing_services: do you need a full packing service for your entire home or just partial packing like kitchen only or bedroom only?
evidence_quotes.box_count: Not asked. No mention of typical box count or overflow check.
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_routing: Since you're moving from a large home with packing service, we usually do a virtual walkthrough... And I can give you an accurate estimate, you can depend on. Are you comfortable doing virtual walkthrough? [Customer agrees.] Correctly routed; virtual walkthrough scheduled for 2:30 PM with link sent via text.

top_strength: Nicole expertly handled multiple complex logistics concerns (storage-unit two-leg move, elevator reservations, third-party pod clarification, artwork/specialty items) and correctly routed a large move with full packing service to a virtual walkthrough instead of attempting to price on this call.
coaching_note: When the customer raised their primary concern about expensive items and damage, Nicole acknowledged it but never asked a follow-up question ('tell me more about that') and did not reflect back what she heard before jumping to the damage coverage solution—two critical moves that would have deepened trust before pivoting to your answer.
